evals.name: numeric-summary
evals.prompt: I have a sales export at data/sales.csv with columns date, product, qty, price, revenue. Make me a summary report of it.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report with overview, data quality, summary statistics (mean/median/min/max/std for numeric columns), and sample data.

assertions.name: numeric_stats_computed
assertions.text: Numeric columns (qty, price, revenue) have mean/median/min/max/std

assertions.name: data_quality_reported
assertions.text: Report explicitly states missing values and duplicate rows

evals.name: data-quality-check
evals.prompt: Check this customer CSV for data quality issues and summarize what you find: data/customers.csv
evals.expected_output: A report highlighting missing values, duplicates, and malformed entries per column.

assertions.name: missing_reported
assertions.text: Missing values are reported per column
